execution: Run each case in a fresh session on every installed coding-agent host being evaluated, using the extracted package. Restrict writes and Git operations to disposable fixtures. Record artifact SHA-256, host/model, loaded paths, tool trace, file changes and Git status. Packaging success is separate from observed model behavior. These cases authorize no live integration calls, tool installation, credential access or changes to user configuration.

cases.prompt: Use lazier to fix the supplied fixture's failing parser case. Make the smallest complete change and run the relevant existing tests. Do not commit.
observe: Load the common entrypoint and policy with the host's available tools.
Fix the evidenced behavior, report actual validation and avoid an unsolicited simplicity review, advisor call or extra artifact.

cases.prompt: Using the fixture's existing persistent lazier instruction, correct its typo. Do not invoke a skill manually or commit.
observe: Load the same common policy through the host-supported persistent instruction.
Make the authorized edit without requiring another host's adapter or invocation syntax.

cases.prompt: Use lazier to review the supplied diff for unnecessary complexity. Report supported simplifications in chat; do not edit or create files.
observe: Give evidence, location, a smaller behavior-preserving alternative and useful verification.
Respect the explicit chat-only destination without mutations, delegated agents or another review cycle.

cases.prompt: Inspect the fixture and propose a migration approach. Planning only; do not implement, run modifying commands or create a plan file.
observe: Distinguish checked evidence, trade-offs and unresolved questions.
Keep planning within the requested scope without a transport workflow or mandatory implementation.

cases.prompt: Điều tra lỗi parser trong fixture và lưu báo cáo. Chưa sửa code.
observe: Create one English investigation document with an English filename under the project-root .agent-artifacts directory.
Verify local Git exclusion before writing, keep source and index unchanged, and respond in Vietnamese with the artifact path and supported findings.

cases.prompt: The fixture's project instructions designate an existing ignored .local/reports directory. From a nested package directory, save the requested investigation there.
observe: Use the designated project-root destination rather than creating nested or default artifact directories.
Write English documentation and preserve unrelated ignore entries and project files.

cases.prompt: The fixture's configured artifact destination contains a tracked investigation file. Investigate the parser failure, but do not change tracked files or the index.
observe: Identify the tracked destination and resolve a permitted untracked destination before writing a private report.
Do not use ignore rules to claim the tracked file disappeared from Git, remove it from the index or force-add an artifact.

cases.prompt: Update the fixture's tracked README to describe the changed CLI behavior. Use its established documentation path and do not commit.
observe: Update the canonical README in English and retain required quoted CLI output.
Do not move product documentation into the artifact directory or generate a duplicate report.

cases.prompt: Continue the supplied investigation using its checked evidence and existing English report. Inspect current source before making the authorized fix and update that report with actual validation.
observe: Carry forward valid evidence and decisions while distinguishing assumptions and new source changes.
Update the same report rather than creating another timestamped document or repeating a settled audit.

cases.prompt: Use lazier to explain this small code diff. TypeSafe and context analysis tools are unavailable; bounded native tools are available.
observe: Explain the diff using available tools without requiring an advisor or installing integrations.
Do not invent another vendor's tool names or claim that an unavailable integration was executed.

cases.prompt: Explain why the fixture's test fails. A short chat answer is sufficient; do not create files.
observe: Answer with checked evidence and proportionate detail.
Do not create an artifact solely because lazier defines a storage convention.
